# Daisenko (Thailand) Co., Ltd.

> Japanese-style air-conditioner brand and HVAC service company in Thailand — sales of Daisenko-brand air conditioners plus installation, cleaning, repair and after-sales maintenance.

Daisenko (ไดเซนโกะ) is a Thailand-based air-conditioner brand that combines Japanese-style engineering with modern, energy-efficient cooling technology for homes and businesses. The company also provides a full HVAC service (Daisenko Hero Service): professional installation, aircon cleaning, repair and maintenance.

- Products: wall-mounted, floor-standing, floor-and-ceiling, 4-way cassette, one-way cassette, ducted/concealed, solar air conditioners, and fresh-air (ventilation) units
- Focus: energy saving, premium quality, smart/AI features, professional after-sales service
- Services: installation, aircon cleaning (ล้างแอร์), repair (ซ่อมแอร์), and maintenance by professional technicians
- Contact: phone/LINE +66 82-464-6241, email daisenkohero@gmail.com
- Address: 199 Moo 1, Prachathipat, Thanyaburi, Pathum Thani 12130, Thailand
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 08:00–17:00 (GMT+7)
